items.title: Neuron on a San Francisco Cable Car
items.prompt: A fantastical, cinematic portrait depicts an anthropomorphic neuron riding the outer footboard of a classic San Francisco cable car during prime time. The character possesses a massive, circular neuronal head with dozens of long dendrites radiating outwards like a crown, displaying a texture of pale purple, magenta, and flesh-gray with a subtle organic sheen. The face is blurred and featureless. The figure is dressed in Victorian or Edwardian gentleman's attire: a dark tweed jacket, patterned vest, shirt, tie, pinstripe trousers, polished brown shoes, and a pocket watch chain. One hand grips the brass pole of the cable car, while the other holds a vintage transit ticket inscribed "MUNICIPAL RAILWAY SAN FRANCISCO ADMIT ONE," accompanied by a small, round lapel badge bearing the word "MUNI." A slender, purple, axonal tail curls behind the body. The cable car is richly detailed, made of lacquered wood and brass, with a route sign on the side reading "POWELL AND MARKET / HYDE AND BEACH / FISHERMANS WHARF". The background shows a steep San Francisco street, with the cable car track extending into the distance. A second cable car is visible below a hillside in the distance, flanked by dense city buildings, and the Coit Tower is visible on the hazy mountaintop. The warm, nostalgic lighting, shallow depth of field, ultra-fine textures, surrealism, humorous yet elegant atmosphere, and centered full-body vertical composition all contribute to the overall effect.
